name: function-with-included-record-param-4dd158ffbe/included-record-params-e.bal
spec_references: Module-level declarations: Supports required-params, defaultable-params, included-record-param and rest-param in the signature
Named and default arguments: Named arguments and omitted defaultable arguments are supported for function calls when the callee has an atomic function type with a known parameter signature.
Object/class definitions: Supports included-record-param, rest-param and defaultable-param in methods
Expressions: Field access expression; Optional field access expression; Member access expression; Mapping constructor; New expression
reason: This negative case checks included-record parameter declarations and argument binding: duplicate exposed names, missing or invalid arguments, forbidden mixtures of whole-record and field arguments, invalid parameter ordering/types, and invalid record field access. Included record parameters and named calls to these statically known functions and class methods are supported. Record types, optional never fields, open/closed rest fields, and the remaining expressions have no applicable exclusion. Rejection of undefined Boo and nonrecord included parameters is within the supported declaration/type system.
test_design_notes: The @error annotations assert compile-time rejection; invalid declarations and calls do not by themselves make this a feature case.
Some calls intentionally exercise recovery after invalid included parameter types without asserting additional errors.
